title: Self-Healing Neural Networks in PyTorch: Fix Model Drift in Real Time Without Retraining
description: What happens when your production model drifts and retraining isn’t an option? This article shows how a self-healing neural network detects drift, adapts in real time using a lightweight adapter, and recovers 27.8% accuracy—without retraining or downtime.
